messages:
Marcus: Quick heads-up 12: Veridian submitted a renewal ask: shift to a 9-month term with ~10% concession. They insist on PO-only.
Lina: Which SKU and seat count?
Marcus: 120 seats, Enterprise. Current commit $72,000/yr; customer proposes $54k for 9 months.
Jeff: Hm. We rarely do 9-months. Any business reason?
Marcus: Procurement aligned to their fiscal year; they cant push a 12-month commitment into next fiscal.
Sara: Onboarding note: two enablement sessions outstanding. We can offer concierge scheduling during the renewal window to increase perceived value.
BillingOps: We saw the DocuSign timeout yesterday SSO redirect issue. We can accept emailed signed PDF as fallback but that triggers manual billing intake (~48h).
Lina: @LegalBot any red flags for a promotional 9-month amendment?
LegalBot: Permissible. Recommend a clear reversion clause and enumerated accepted execution methods (DocuSign, PO, or emailed signed PDF with signer block). Add PO issuance deadline.
Jeff: Commercial proposal: 9 months at 85% of annual rate, reversion to published rates at next renewal; PO required by EOW or default to monthly CC billing until PO received.
Marcus: Can we accept emailed PDF if DocuSign fails again?
BillingOps: Yes; prefer DocuSign for audit trail. Manual intake requires a cover email confirming signer name/title to speed processing.
Marcus: Risk: procurement could delay >2 weeks. Recommend AE director escalation if PO not received within 72 hours.
Lina: I'll draft the amendment with reversion language and execution clause. ETA EOD.
Jeff: Escalating procurement contact now (subject: vendor code + expedited PO for Veridian renewal). :email:
Sara: I'll schedule the remaining enablement sessions as a concierge kickoff next week to sweeten the renewal.
Marcus: Draft amendment excerpt: 
``
- Term: 9 months starting 2026-04-01
- Fee: 85% of annual commit, prorated for 9 months
- Reversion: At the conclusion of this amendment term, pricing will revert to Redwood's then-published standard rates unless the parties expressly agree in writing to different pricing
- Execution: This amendment may be executed via DocuSign, an official PO referencing Redwood's agreement, or an emailed signed PDF containing the authorized signer's printed name and title
```
LegalBot: Wording good; suggest an explicit PO issuance deadline (2026-03-27) and acceptance checklist for PDF execution.
Marcus: Updated amendment uploaded (v2) with PO deadline and PDF signer checklist.
BillingOps: Standing by to process. If PDF is used, include a cover note confirming signer name/title to expedite manual entry.
Jeff: Procurement replied: vendor code approved; aim to issue PO by Friday 12:00pm.
Marcus: Excellent. Keeping thread open until PO arrives. Will escalate per plan if missed. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
